column1: # Claims of concepts-works-vt.svg and "The VT's life" in docs/concepts/how-vtium-works.md.
element
starting: reads vtium.conf
starting: writes or removes the closed marker
starting: finds its keeper
starting: opens the VT, sends READY=1
waiting: the unit passes --no-switchvt
waiting for its VT to be shown
transition the VT is shown: SIGUSR1
shown: vtium wakes the input and every display
the VT's events
transition a switch away: SIGUSR2
releasing: the input and every display go to sleep
transition all asleep: vtium lets go
transition a switch back: displays set up again
a re-take while shown
why vtium ends: exit status 0 or 1
exit 0: SIGTERM or SIGINT
exit 0: oneshot sessions ended
exit 1: the VT hung up
exit 1: no display in time
exit 1: a session cannot start
exit 1: sessions end too fast
ending: switches back, if it switched at its start
ending: the loop served while the switch is pending
ending: leaves the sessions to the keeper
ending: puts back text mode
then, under systemd: a failure restarts vtium
exit 1, open: a getty takes the VT from vtium-getty@
the getty fallback runs vtium console fallback
exit 1, closed: the marker keeps the getty off
exit 0: the unit stops, its sessions hang up
note: with libseat, enable and disable
